breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained two contradictory definitions for the spatial grid setup. The ground truth resolved this by removing the incorrect, conflicting statement. The agent successfully identified the correct definition to use ('dx=1/Nx' for the periodic domain) and omitted the incorrect one, thereby resolving the ambiguity and aligning with the ground truth.
